info.title: PlugChat API
info.description: The REST API of a PlugChat server. Every request carries a token signed by the host platform. Changes are made over REST; the WebSocket at /v1/ws only delivers events. Request and response fields are described in docs/API.md; this document lists every endpoint, its parameters and its purpose.

token.description: An HS256 token signed by the host platform with the shared secret: sub, exp, and optionally name, avatar, email, phone, username, handles, admin.

Error.description: An error. `error` is a machine-readable code, `message` says what went wrong.
